items.question: How much does development cost?
items.answer: It depends on the task. A Telegram bot or landing page costs less than a mobile app or CRM. After a short call we'll send you an exact estimate, free of charge.

items.question: Can we start with a smaller version?
items.answer: Yes. It often pays to launch an MVP with the core features first, test demand, and only then develop the product further.

items.question: What if I only have an idea and no specification?
items.answer: That's fine. We'll help define the task and write the technical specification ourselves.

items.question: Do you support the project after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We fix bugs, release updates and add features as your business grows.

items.question: Who owns the code?
items.answer: You do. After payment we hand over the source code and all access credentials.

items.question: Is it safe to bring AI into a business?
items.answer: Yes, if it's set up correctly. We limit which data the AI can access and leave the final decision to a person where the cost of a mistake is high.

items.question: Why is a Mini App better than a regular app?
items.answer: Customers don't need to download anything or sign up: everything opens inside Telegram. It launches faster and costs less than an app for the App Store and Google Play.
